prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 17 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1354; do not mention it.)
text:
Treatment Summary

Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the patient's vehicle was sideswiped while changing lanes. The patient reported immediate onset of neck pain with stiffness and lower back pain radiating into the paraspinal muscles, along with intermittent headaches. Examination revealed restricted cervical range of motion, tenderness over the cervical and lumbar paraspinal muscles, and muscle guarding without neurological deficit. Imaging was not indicated at initial evaluation given the absence of red-flag findings.

Over the course of 17 visits, treatment consisted of manual therapy, targeted therapeutic exercise for cervical and lumbar stabilization, posture education, and modalities for pain control as needed. Pain scores and range of motion improved steadily across the treatment period, and headache frequency decreased substantially after the first month of care.

At discharge, the patient demonstrated near-full cervical and lumbar range of motion, minimal residual paraspinal tenderness, and independent performance of a home exercise program. Remaining symptoms are occasional and activity-related. The patient is expected to continue home exercises and return only if symptoms recur or worsen.
